description: Official Go client for the Checkslip API: look up a Thai bank transfer with the sending bank from the QR code on a slip or from a photo of it. No dependencies outside the standard library.
rules: Install with go get github.com/Checkslip/sdk-go. The package name is checkslip.
Create the client with checkslip.NewClient(apiKey, opts...). Every method takes a context.Context first.
Look up a slip with Slips.Lookup(ctx, &checkslip.LookupParams{QR: qr}) or with Image set instead. Set one or the other, never both.
Lists come in pairs: List returns one page, ListAll returns an iterator that walks every page.
Read the API key from the environment and keep it on a server. Never hard-code it and never ship it to a browser.
Checkslip looks up the transfer with the sending bank and returns what the bank holds. It does not judge whether a slip is real or fake; accepting the payment is the caller's decision.
Amounts come back in satang, where 100 satang is 1 baht. Account numbers come back as the last four digits only.
FOUND, NOT_FOUND, DUPLICATE and PENDING are normal outcomes and are returned, not raised. Only a problem with the request itself is an error.
A 202 answer is a success, not a failure: the outcome is PENDING and the result arrives later by webhook or by reading the lookup again.
Pass your own idempotency key when a job can be retried across processes, so a repeat returns the first answer and is never charged twice.
Check the signature of every webhook before trusting it, and pass both secrets during a rotation.
